testcase.name: Stale callbacks: a callback from a cancelled generation never plans, also after an M8-only restart
Shutdown: close disposes M8 effects and rings, cancels the task, refuses later starts, and stale ticks do nothing
Natural end and termination: finished effects are disposed in the tick, and the task is cancelled when nothing remains
Ring and M8 together: exactly one planning call per tick containing both requests; one task
Aura only: first M8 start schedules the one task; each tick plans once with the aura request; stop cancels
Stationary trail with no live samples: task keeps lightweight ticks, planner is skipped, zero report; moving resumes planning
